title: Larry Hancock: UAP at nuclear facilities 1949-1953, then stopped

tellings.quote: And what they found was high levels of activity from 1949 until 1953, and then it just stopped.

plain: Strange objects in the sky were reported often at US nuclear sites from 1949 to 1953, and then the reports simply stopped, according to a study by the researcher Larry Hancock in an article for a group of scientists who study unexplained aerial sightings. A researcher named Steven Bruel relays the finding on the show: "what they found was high levels of activity from 1949 until 1953, and then it just stopped." If true, it would suggest whatever was being seen had a particular interest in nuclear weapons during those years.
